title: Mirabel and the Cover
premise: Casper Villalobos, a veteran interpreter for a doomed peace delegation, has spent two decades erasing himself from every record that could connect him to the Handler's network that trained him as a child asset. When a stranger named Iva repays a favor Casper never performed—saving his life in a way he doesn't remember—he realizes his memory has been edited and the network is reactivating its alumni ahead of a summit meant to fail. To survive, Casper must reconstruct who he was before the edits, turn the network's own interpreters against it, and burn the Handler's archive before the summit convenes. In the end he trades his anonymity for justice: the network falls, but only because Casper publicly becomes the man he spent twenty years pretending not to be.
about_author: Xanthe Marchetti is a former conference interpreter who spent a decade working behind glass booths at summits across three continents before turning to fiction. She writes thrillers about people whose professions require them to have no opinions of their own.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: POV Casper. A stranger, Iva, corners Casper after a delegation briefing and thanks him for saving her life in Sarajevo—a memory Casper does not have. She leaves an envelope: photographs of him at ages he can't account for. Emotional beat: the floor tilts under a life built on careful invisibility.

chapters.title: Twenty Years of Rewritten Rules
chapters.summary: POV Casper. He audits his own past—passports, references, gaps—and finds the seams too clean. His handler-era instincts resurface: he checks for surveillance and finds it. Emotional beat: dread curdling into the old professional calm he thought he'd buried.

chapters.title: Iva's Ledger
chapters.summary: POV Iva. She explains the debt: someone in the network saved her using Casper's name, and now the network collects favors with interest. She shows him a list of eleven names—alumni being recalled before the summit. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance between two people trained not to trust.

chapters.title: The Delegation Destined to Fail
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Back at work, he notices the summit's translation schedule has been quietly manipulated—certain interpreters assigned to certain rooms. The peace process is being sabotaged from inside the booth. Emotional beat: righteous anger at rules weaponized against peace.

chapters.title: What the Mirror Won't Say
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Under hypnosis from a retired network doctor, Casper recovers a fragment: a boy in a basement, repeating phrases in six languages. The favor Iva remembers was real—his edited self erased it. Emotional beat: grief for a childhood spent as equipment.

chapters.title: Alumni
chapters.summary: POV Iva. She tracks down another name on the list, a retired diplomat who denies everything until she speaks a trigger phrase; his face goes blank mid-sentence. The conditioning still works. Emotional beat: horror at how deep the training runs.

chapters.title: The Handler's Handwriting
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Decoding the summit schedule as a cipher, Casper finds the Handler's signature in the assignment pattern—the same hand that wrote his childhood drills. The network isn't just surviving; it's running the summit. Emotional beat: cold clarity of purpose.

chapters.title: A Room With Two Exits
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Meeting an insider contact, Casper walks into a trap staged by the network—but escapes using a route drilled into him decades ago, one he didn't know he knew. Emotional beat: terror that his body obeys them better than he obeys himself.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: POV Iva. The network calls in her debt: deliver Casper or become a liability. She stalls, then confesses everything to him. Emotional beat: betrayal offered as honesty, trust chosen anyway.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Booths
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Following the cipher, they locate the archive: a records vault beneath the summit venue holding every alumnus's file—including Casper's original identity. Emotional beat: hope with a timer on it.

chapters.title: Eleven Names
chapters.summary: POV rotating among alumni. Short vignettes of the other nine recalled assets: some loyal, some broken, one already dead by the network's hand. Emotional beat: the scale of the machine revealed through individual ruin.

chapters.title: Rules for Burning a Network
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Planning session: they can't go to authorities—the network owns the oversight bodies. They must turn the alumni, expose the sabotage mid-summit, and destroy the archive simultaneously. Emotional beat: resolve hardening into strategy.

chapters.title: The Interpreter Who Refused
chapters.summary: POV new character, Marek, an alumnus on the list. Contacted by Casper, he wavers between loyalty and freedom, then chooses defection after seeing his own file's kill order. Emotional beat: the first domino tipping.

chapters.title: Rehearsal
chapters.summary: POV Iva. Dry run of the plan inside the venue; she poses as staff while mapping guard rotations. The Handler's surveillance catches a fraction of it. Emotional beat: competence shadowed by the sense of being watched.

chapters.title: The Man I Was Before
chapters.summary: POV Casper. The doctor restores more memory: Casper's real name, his mother, the favor he actually did perform in Sarajevo. He weeps for the first time in twenty years. Emotional beat: identity returning like blood to a numb limb.

chapters.title: Summit Eve
chapters.summary: POV Casper. The Handler contacts Casper directly—through the summit's PA system, using a childhood trigger phrase. Half the room freezes; Casper fights it off. Emotional beat: open war declared in a language only they speak.

chapters.title: Every Booth at Once
chapters.summary: POV multiple. Summit opens; the sabotage begins—mistranslations engineered to spark walkouts. Casper and turned alumni counter in real time, correcting the record line by line. Emotional beat: battle fought entirely in words.

chapters.title: The Vault
chapters.summary: POV Casper and Iva. While the summit distracts security, they breach the archive. Casper finds his file—and learns the Handler is the doctor who 'treated' him, the one person he trusted with his memories. Emotional beat: the last safe person unmasked.

chapters.title: Interest Paid
chapters.summary: POV Iva. Confrontation with the Handler; she takes a bullet meant for Casper, buying him the seconds to seize the archive master key. Emotional beat: sacrifice repaying a debt in the only currency left.

chapters.title: Burning the Training
chapters.summary: POV Casper. He broadcasts the archive to every delegate's screen and ignites the physical vault, destroying the leverage over all eleven alumni. The Handler is arrested mid-translation, undone by his own cipher. Emotional beat: catharsis through fire and exposure.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: POV Casper. At the inquiry, Casper testifies under his real name, dismantling the network publicly so no rewritten rule can resurrect it. The summit, freed of sabotage, limps toward an honest failure rather than a manufactured one. Emotional beat: justice outside the law, finished inside it.

chapters.title: Mirabel
chapters.summary: POV Casper. Weeks later, he visits Iva's grave, then a small town called Mirabel where his mother once lived. He introduces himself to a stranger by his true name—for the first time without flinching. Emotional beat: quiet, earned peace; visibility chosen at last.
